prose: TechCrunch reports that Mecka, which collects human motion data to train humanoid and other robots, raised a $60 million Series B led by Sequoia, with Nvidia, M12 and others taking part.
The excerpt describes the business as collecting and analyzing human motion data for robot training. Valuation and customers are not given in what was reviewed.
highlights: Mecka raises $60M Series B led by Sequoia
Sells human motion data for training robots
